Name: Seasonal Colored Seeds and Saplings for Crop Mods
Author: jalfje
Description:
Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3774]Seasonal Colored Seeds by Laula[/url], I was finding it difficult to keep track of the seasons of the crops from all the mods I have installed, so I tried to fix that. That mod isn't a strict dependency, but you really should use it.

This mod can be used for just the vanilla saplings retextures. The mod automatically detects the presence of any mods it supports, and will work on any supported mods you have installed (which could be none).

Seed packets for packet-less seeds can be toggled on/off.
Seasonally-colored saplings can be toggled on/off.

Mods Supported:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers
[/url]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20340]Growable Forage and Crop Bushes[/url] *
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25619]Vanilla Forage and Crop Bushes[/url]

(* = partial, vanilla replacements of crops with crop bushes not yet supported)

Let me know if there are other popular crop mods for 1.6 and I'll consider adding patches for them as well, or add a PR to the github page.

Mods on the to-do list:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20951]Growable Vine Crops[/url] (this mod doesn't actually add textures, so I'll be adding bush textures and making them seasonal at the same time)
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25788]Ridgeside Forage and Crop Bushes[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26731]Stardew Valley Expanded Forage and Crop Bushes[/url]

Source link: https://github.com/jalfje/stardew-mods/tree/main/Seasonal-Seeds-And-Saplings
